player.anchor_origin: top-left of cropped frame, source pixels

presentation_tuning.scope: Runtime integration target supplied by root; engine QA and actual stance slip still require real game capture

player.contact: At least one authored supporting shoe reaches the y104 source ground line in every walk pose. Recovering foot folds at knee; root foot anchor never translates.
player.breathing: Leg paths are byte-identical in all four idle poses. Only upper-body geometry moves: chest <=0.5px, head <=0.225px. No whole-person vertical transform while idle.
player.proportion: Approximately3.1 crown-to-jaw head lengths from crown to sole; short neck, jaw shadow and relaxed asymmetry. Cloth/headband follow the step by a half phase.
player.time_authority: Runtime supplies real walked distance for walk phases and existing frozen/resumed ambient_elapsed for idle; SVG owns no state or clock

tea_seller.anchor_origin: top-left of cropped frame, source pixels
tea_seller.facing: down; original adult brown-clothed male seller, fine moustache retained
tea_seller.working_pose_contract: Original sleeves/hands/cup/cloth trajectory coordinates and order retained from original generator; new short-neck head, relaxed torso/apron and locally coloured shadows. No shoulder/hand/cup group translations.
tea_seller.time_authority: existing seller life frame_index_at(stage ambient_elapsed), period14s

tea_patron.anchor_origin: top-left of cropped frame, source pixels
tea_patron.contact_contract: Exact original leg and seated body curves, transforms and source anchors retained. Local-colour edges and broad cloth/neck/face planes added without translating seat, feet or hand/cup trajectory.
tea_patron.time_authority: existing patron life frame_index_at(stage ambient_elapsed), period12s
